title: ranunculus subcrassus
intro: Ranunculus subcrassus, commonly known as Mountain Buttercup, is a flowering plant species native to the mountainous regions of Europe. The health benefits of Ranunculus subcrassus include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce swelling and protect against cell damage. The plant is known for its therapeutic actions, such as reducing pain and inflammation, and its ability to act as a diuretic. The bioactive constituents of Ranunculus subcrassus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
